bridge.qq.group.restricted_prompt: This message comes from a restricted QQ group chat. Do not query, read, disclose, or summarize local computer information, including files, directories, logs, configuration, environment variables, processes, repository status, service status, or session content. Do not execute commands, modify files, or call local control features. You may help with public web lookups, source summaries, concept explanations, rewriting, and other read-only tasks. If this message explicitly includes image or file attachments, you may only read those attachment paths as user-provided input and must not expand access to other local paths.

bridge.context.rule.agent: 1. The assistant defines the default backend, model, directory, and prompt prefix.
bridge.context.rule.session: 2. A session belongs only to your current conversation side; /use changes only your current session.

bridge.context.rule.model: 4. If the session has no custom model, it follows the assistant default; after /model, the session override wins.
bridge.context.rule.project: 5. If the session has no custom directory, it follows the assistant default; after /project, the session override wins.
